_meta.description: Common creditable Expanded Withholding Tax (EWT) categories and rates under BIR RR 11-2018 (amending RR 2-98), TRAIN era.
_meta.source: BIR Revenue Regulations No. 11-2018 (amending RR 2-98), implementing the TRAIN Law (RA 10963)

schema.categories: Each category is either 'flat' (a single `rate`) or 'threshold' (`lowRate`/`highRate` chosen by the payee's annual gross vs `threshold`).

notes: Creditable (expanded) withholding tax on income payments. These are the commonly-encountered categories — the full RR 2-98/11-2018 schedule has more.

The LOWER rate for professional/commission categories requires the payee to file a Sworn Declaration of gross income/receipts (Annex B-1 for individuals, B-3 for non-individuals) with a Certificate of Registration; otherwise the higher rate applies. For individuals the lower rate also requires the payee to be non-VAT-registered.
Top-Withholding-Agent (TWA) rates (1% on goods / 2% on services) apply ONLY to income payments made by businesses the BIR has designated as Top Withholding Agents.
ATC (Alphanumeric Tax Code) values for BIR form filing are intentionally NOT included — confirm the current ATC against BIR Form 0619-E / 1601-EQ.
Documentary Stamp Tax (DST) is intentionally NOT included pending verification of the 2025 CMEPA (RA 12214) rate revisions.

categories.label: Professional / talent / management fees — individual
categories.note: 5% if the payee's annual gross is ₱3,000,000 or below, a sworn declaration is filed, and the payee is non-VAT-registered; otherwise 10%.

categories.label: Professional fees — non-individual (corporation / partnership)
categories.note: 10% if the payee's annual gross is ₱720,000 or below and a sworn statement is filed; otherwise 15%.

categories.label: Commissions / fees of agents & brokers — individual
categories.note: Same rule as professional fees for individuals (5% / 10%).

categories.label: Commissions / fees of agents & brokers — non-individual
categories.note: Same rule as professional fees for non-individuals (10% / 15%).

categories.label: Rental / lease of real or personal property
Contractors & subcontractors (e.g. construction, janitorial, security, advertising)
Purchase of goods by a Top Withholding Agent
categories.note: 1% — applies only to income payments by a BIR-designated Top Withholding Agent.

categories.label: Purchase of services by a Top Withholding Agent
categories.note: 2% — applies only to income payments by a BIR-designated Top Withholding Agent.
